name: Pressurized Bottle (3-4)
disable: DC 20 Thievery check (trained) to carefully place the bottle under a bucket or bowl.

items.name: Brittle Shatter
items.text:
Trigger A creature tries to pick up or move the potion

---

Effect The bottle shatters into pieces that fill a 5-foot burst. The burst deals 4 piercing damage (DC 22 basic Reflex save save). A creature who takes any damage is exposed to fermented potion.

items.name: Fermented Poison
items.text:
Saving Throw DC 22 Fortitude save

Maximum Duration 4 hours

Stage 1 1d6 poison damage and Clumsy 1 (1 hour)

Stage 2 1d8 poison damage and Clumsy 2 (1 hour)

Stage 3 2d8 poison damage and clumsy 2 (1 hour)

text: One of the potions has decayed, putting it under immense pressure. Its contents have become poisonous. When handled improperly, the bottle bursts, sending glass shards flying everywhere.
